titolo: Putin's Bridge Falls Into the Sea Before the Xi-Trump Summit
angolo: The bridge Putin drove across himself in 2018 has lost its road arch two days before he sits down with Trump and Xi, and what each side says it means.
descrizione: Putin's Bridge Falls Into the Sea Before the Xi-Trump Summit. Ukraine says a seven-stage operation collapsed the road arch of the Kerch Bridge, the crossing Putin opened in 2018, while Russia hit Kyiv's bridges overnight. The Kremlin says the bridge will be rebuilt. Two days later Putin is due in Shenzhen with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. Here is what is confirmed, what each side says, and what happens next.
tag: Putin's Bridge Falls Into the Sea Before the Xi-Trump Summit

scene.testo: Zelensky says an arched span of the Kerch Bridge's road section, more than 270 meters long, collapsed after Ukrainian strikes.
Videos and images posted by Zelensky and verified by Reuters show the main road arch fell into the strait, leaving a gap in the roadway.
It is the bridge Vladimir Putin personally opened in 2018. And it is two days before he is due to meet Trump and Xi.
So what does a damaged bridge mean for Putin, as he heads into the biggest summit of his year?
In May 2018, Putin drove a Russian-made dump truck across this bridge himself.
Russia had annexed Crimea in 2014. Ukraine and most of the world never recognized it.
The bridge cost about 223 billion rubles, around 3.6 billion dollars, according to reports at the time.
Stretching about 19 kilometers across the Kerch Strait, it links the Krasnodar region to the Crimean city of Kerch.
At the opening, Putin told workers that, in his words, this project, this miracle, had happened.

citazione.testo: At last, thanks to your talent, this project, this miracle, has happened

scene.testo: Many in Russia saw the bridge as a symbol of Moscow's claim to Crimea. Kyiv and the West condemned it as a violation of Ukraine's sovereignty.
But Ukraine never accepted it. And the bridge became a target.
October 2022, one day after Putin's 70th birthday: a truck bomb blast. Parts of the road collapsed, and Russian investigators said three people were killed.
Putin called the blast a terrorist act and accused Kyiv, according to the PBS report. Ukrainian officials did not directly claim responsibility at the time.
But that is not the whole story. This time, Ukraine says it used a seven-stage operation.
Zelensky says the strike was the seventh and final stage of an operation weeks in the making, run by the SBU and the General Staff.
First, Zelensky says, Ukraine methodically destroyed Russian air defenses, radar systems and electronic warfare capabilities.
Then came the bridge. On Monday, a Ukrainian strike damaged the bridge, and traffic was suspended for a time.
Traffic resumed after a pause, and the bridge stayed standing. Then came Tuesday.
According to Zelensky, Palianytsia drones hit the road section, while Neptune missiles, Ruta and FP-5 drones struck the railway.
Zelensky said every weapon was Ukrainian-made. Kyiv's Security Service says its Alpha special forces fired the Palianytsia drones.
Ukraine's General Staff says an arch and a span of the road section collapsed, and the rail section is still standing but its arch is damaged.
NBC News geolocated photos and videos showing a section collapsed into the water.
Zelensky called it an unprecedented operation. He said Ukraine was responding to Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure.
But that is not the whole story. Russia was striking Kyiv's bridges too, in the same overnight attacks.
Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the North and South bridges over the Dnipro were hit.

citazione.testo: According to preliminary information, there have been hits on the North and South bridges in the capital.

scene.testo: Zelensky said Russia targeted two of Kyiv's main bridges with ballistic missiles, four at the Southern Bridge and three at the Northern Bridge, though he did not say how many hit each.
The attack caused water and power cuts in parts of the capital, the mayor said.
Kyiv's two main bridges were damaged and closed, and part of the metro system was damaged, according to officials.
Russia's defense ministry said it hit transport, military and energy facilities in the Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Cherkasy and Dnipropetrovsk regions.
Russia also said it downed 2,049 Ukrainian drones in 24 hours, a figure Russian officials said was a record.

grafica.sopra: RUSSIA SAYS IT DOWNED IN 24 HOURS

scene.testo: Crimea's Russian-installed governor, Sergey Aksyonov, said two people were killed in a drone strike in a district near the bridge, and traffic across the bridge was suspended.
Russia's Investigative Committee confirmed the attack and called it a "terrorist act by Ukrainian armed groups."
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Putin was briefed by Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin after a government commission met.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said there was "no doubt that the bridge will be restored" and that it would be even better than before.

citazione.testo: There is no doubt that the bridge will be restored and will be even better than it was before.

scene.testo: Khusnullin wrote on Telegram that resources, designers and builders had already been assembled for the repairs.
Peskov says the bridge will be restored, though some pro-war Russian commentators said repairs would be very difficult.
Rail traffic partially resumed on Tuesday, according to Aksyonov and TASS, as reported by CNN and Inquisitr.
Aksyonov said people without vehicles could cross by ferry.
The Guardian reports that with the bridge closed, traffic out of Crimea can only use a land corridor through occupied southern Ukraine, which is vulnerable to Ukrainian drones.
The collapsed section extended over the main shipping channel linking the Sea of Azov and the Black Sea.
UK Defense Secretary Wes Streeting, speaking at NATO headquarters in Brussels, called it "another example of Ukrainian ingenuity."
In two days, Putin is due to meet Xi Jinping and Donald Trump in Shenzhen.
China's foreign ministry confirmed the meeting, and the Kremlin confirmed Putin's participation. It is expected to be the first three-way summit of the three leaders.
A White House spokesperson said Trump will discuss nuclear weapons reduction at the meeting.
But Trump said he would also talk about what he called his favorite subject, Ukraine.

citazione.testo: We'll talk about my favorite subject: Ukraine.

scene.testo: A White House official earlier said Ukraine was not intended to come up, and that no separate Putin-Trump meeting was planned. Trump later said otherwise about Ukraine.
Ukraine will not have a representative at the meeting.
NPR reports that Europe and Ukraine are concerned about how Ukraine may be discussed at the meeting.
Reuters, as carried by CBC, called the timing awkward for the Kremlin leader.
What is reported: Ukraine and Russian officials say the road arch fell, rail traffic partly resumed per Russian reports, and Kyiv's bridges were hit.
What is still unclear: how long repairs will take, and the identities of those killed near the bridge.
Moscow's Investigative Committee calls the strike a terrorist act. Kyiv says it was a response. Two bridges in Kyiv, one in Crimea.
On Thursday, Putin is due to meet Trump and Xi, after his bridge was cut by Ukrainian strikes.
